```{r, message=FALSE}
source("Lib_Preprocess.R")

set.seed(1991)
options(scipen = 999)


### PREPROCESAMIENTO ###


df.Position <- read.csv(
  "Position_Salaries.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)

df.Position$Position <- NULL

summary(df.Position)
```

## Summary

Level           Salary       
 Min.   : 1.00   Min.   :  45000  
 1st Qu.: 3.25   1st Qu.:  65000  
 Median : 5.50   Median : 130000  
 Mean   : 5.50   Mean   : 249500  
 3rd Qu.: 7.75   3rd Qu.: 275000  
 Max.   :10.00   Max.   :1000000
 
```{r, message=FALSE}
plot(df.Position)

### MODELO LINEAL ###


mdl.lineal.Position <- lm(
  formula = Salary ~ Level,
  data = df.Position
)

summary(mdl.lineal.Position)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
# REGRESION CON VECTORES DE SOPORTE

svr.lin <- svm(
  formula = Salary ~ .,
  data = df.Position,
  kernel = "linear",
  type = "eps-regression"
)

summary(svr.lin)


```

```{r, message=FALSE}
### COMPARACIÓN SVR ###

plt.svr <- ggplot() +
  theme_light() +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = df.Position$Level,
      y = df.Position$Salary
    )
  ) +
  xlab("Nivel de puesto") +
  ylab("Salario") +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = df.Position$Level,
      y = predict(svr.lin, df.Position)
    ),
    colour = "dodgerblue",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = df.Position$Level,
      y = predict(svr.poly, df.Position)
    ),
    colour = "green",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = df.Position$Level,
      y = predict(svr.rad, df.Position)
    ),
    colour = "orange",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = df.Position$Level,
      y = predict(svr.sig, df.Position)
    ),
    colour = "deeppink3",
    linewidth = 1.5
  )

plt.svr

### R² Y R² AJUSTADO ###

Y.pred <- predict(
  svr.rad,
  newdata = df.Position
)

Y.mean <- mean(df.Position$Salary)

SSt <- sum(
  (df.Position$Salary - Y.mean)^2
)

SSr <- sum(
  (df.Position$Salary - Y.pred)^2
)

R.squared <- 1 - (SSr / SSt)

n <- nrow(df.Position)
p <- ncol(df.Position) - 1

Adj.R.squared <- 1 -
  (1 - R.squared) *
  ((n - 1) / (n - p - 1))

R.squared
Adj.R.squared

```

## Resultados

R.squared
[1] 0.7485194
Adj.R.squared
[1] 0.7170843
